name: Quin
description: Handles SQL-based questions end-to-end: generates a SQL query from the project's table metadata, has it reviewed and executed, critiques execution results (retrying on error), turns the result set into a direct answer plus an optional chart, and runs post-generation evaluation to decide whether the question is fully answered or needs a semantic follow-up from Eryl.

sub_agents.name: Sql_Generator
sub_agents.purpose: Generates a valid SQL query from the metadata schema for the given question; returns sql_query: None if the question can't be answered from the schema.

sub_agents.name: Query_Executor
sub_agents.purpose: Reviews the generated SQL for correctness/optimization before execution, then hands off to Sql_tool.

sub_agents.name: Sql_tool
sub_agents.purpose: Executes db_execute_query and returns raw SQL results. No LLM (llm_config=None) — deterministic tool executor.

sub_agents.name: Sql_Execution_Critic
sub_agents.purpose: Reviews execution results/errors; routes back to Sql_Generator with feedback on failure, or forward to Insight_Generator on success.

sub_agents.name: Insight_Generator
sub_agents.purpose: Turns SQL results into a direct answer, a brief inference, and optional Seaborn/matplotlib chart code; self-scores the answer on six quality dimensions.

sub_agents.name: evaluation_agent
sub_agents.purpose: Post-generation evaluator. Scores the answer against the shared rubric, computes composite_score/status, and decides next_agent: user_proxy (done), Sql_Generator (more SQL needed), or query_transformer (hands off to Eryl for a semantic follow-up).

tools.name: db_execute_query
tools.description: Runs `query` via `pandas.read_sql(query, engine)` and returns the result set as a JSON records string. Returns an error string (not an exception) on failure or on an unsupported db_name.

handoff_note: user_proxy and query_transformer are owned by the parent orchestrator and the eryl package respectively. Quin only returns their names via route(); it never imports or instantiates them.

external_resources: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4-class chat deployment, referenced as GPT4_LLM_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_NAME)
SQL database reachable via the SQLAlchemy `engine` object exported from API_unified/config

statefulness: build_agents() is a factory — call it once per conversation/session to get fresh, independent AssistantAgent instances. No module-level agent singletons are created on import.
